items.title: Hide
items.flavour: You find the one place on the pitch where nobody can give you the ball.

outcomes.text: Two moves go down the other side without you. Nobody mentions it.
Vitya finds you anyway and you give it straight back to him.

items.title: Rushed pass
items.flavour: You play it before you have to, because having it is worse.

outcomes.text: It goes to nobody. Their full-back does not even have to move to collect it.
It reaches Kotov, who has to take it going backwards, and says something you do not catch.

items.title: Safe backpass
items.flavour: There is a forward pass. There is also a backward one.

outcomes.text: You go backwards. A man in the third row explains to his son what you should have done.
You go backwards and the move builds again anyway. It costs the team nothing and you know it cost something.

items.title: Heavy legs
items.flavour: The run is there. The legs are on the bus from Thursday.

outcomes.text: You start the run and stop it halfway. The pass goes where you were going to be.
You make the run and arrive a stride late. A stride is the whole thing.

items.title: Hospital ball
items.flavour: The pass is a second late and half a yard short.

outcomes.text: Kotov takes the hit that was meant for you and does not look up.
It skips off the surface and out. Nobody says anything.

items.title: In late
items.flavour: You have decided to go and your legs have not agreed to the timing.

outcomes.text: You get the man and a bit of the ground. Something in the knee registers it and files a complaint.
You get the man. The referee lets it go and their bench does not.
